def file_sha256(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()

2. Reconstruct the full population and its training histories¶

Code (click to collapse)
In [2]:
AGE_LABELS = {1: "Under 18", 18: "18–24", 25: "25–34", 35: "35–44",
              45: "45–49", 50: "50–55", 56: "56+"}
OCC_LABELS = {
    0: "Other / unspecified", 1: "Academic / educator", 2: "Artist", 3: "Clerical / admin",
    4: "College / grad student", 5: "Customer service", 6: "Doctor / health care",
    7: "Executive / managerial", 8: "Farmer", 9: "Homemaker", 10: "K–12 student",
    11: "Lawyer", 12: "Programmer", 13: "Retired", 14: "Sales / marketing", 15: "Scientist",
    16: "Self-employed", 17: "Technician / engineer", 18: "Trades / crafts",
    19: "Unemployed", 20: "Writer",
}
users_raw = pd.read_csv(DATA / "users.dat", sep="::", engine="python", header=None,
                       names=["source_user_id", "gender", "age_code", "occupation_code", "zip_code"],
                       dtype={"source_user_id": "int32", "age_code": "int16",
                              "occupation_code": "int16", "zip_code": str})
ratings = pd.read_csv(DATA / "ratings.dat", sep="::", engine="python", header=None,
                      names=["source_user_id", "source_item_id", "rating", "timestamp"],
                      dtype={"source_user_id": "int32", "source_item_id": "int32",
                             "rating": "int8", "timestamp": "int64"})
ratings["source_row"] = np.arange(len(ratings), dtype=np.int64)
movies = pd.read_csv(DATA / "movies.dat", sep="::", engine="python", header=None,
                     names=["source_item_id", "title", "genres"], encoding="latin-1")
assert len(users_raw) == 6040 and users_raw.source_user_id.is_unique
assert not ratings.duplicated(["source_user_id", "source_item_id"]).any()
assert users_raw.gender.isin(["F", "M"]).all()
assert users_raw.age_code.isin(AGE_LABELS).all()
assert users_raw.occupation_code.isin(OCC_LABELS).all()
assert not users_raw.isna().any().any()

retained = ratings.copy()
filter_rounds = []
while True:
    uc = retained.groupby("source_user_id").size()
    ic = retained.groupby("source_item_id").size()
    keep = (retained.source_user_id.map(uc) >= 5) & (retained.source_item_id.map(ic) >= 5)
    new = retained.loc[keep].copy()  # Both thresholds use the same previous pass.
    filter_rounds.append({"pass": len(filter_rounds) + 1, "input_events": len(retained),
                          "output_events": len(new), "removed_events": len(retained) - len(new)})
    if len(new) == len(retained):
        retained = new
        break
    retained = new
source_user_ids = np.sort(retained.source_user_id.unique())
source_item_ids = np.sort(retained.source_item_id.unique())
assert len(source_user_ids) == 6040, "If the retained target changes, review the population definition."
user_index = {int(value): i for i, value in enumerate(source_user_ids)}
item_index = {int(value): i for i, value in enumerate(source_item_ids)}
retained = retained.sort_values(["source_user_id", "timestamp", "source_row"], kind="stable")
sequence_index = retained.groupby("source_user_id").cumcount()
sequence_size = retained.groupby("source_user_id").source_user_id.transform("size")
assert sequence_size.min() >= 3
training = retained.loc[sequence_index < sequence_size - 2].copy()
held_out = retained.loc[sequence_index >= sequence_size - 2].copy()
assert len(held_out) == 2 * len(source_user_ids)
assert set(training.source_row).isdisjoint(set(held_out.source_row))
training["row"] = training.source_user_id.map(user_index).astype("int32")
training["column"] = training.source_item_id.map(item_index).astype("int32")
catalog = movies.set_index("source_item_id").loc[source_item_ids].copy()

N = len(source_user_ids)
population = users_raw.set_index("source_user_id").loc[source_user_ids].reset_index()
population["runtime_user_id"] = np.arange(1, N + 1)
population["age"] = pd.Categorical(population.age_code.map(AGE_LABELS),
                                   categories=list(AGE_LABELS.values()), ordered=True)
population["occupation"] = population.occupation_code.map(OCC_LABELS)
population["postal_prefix"] = population.zip_code.where(
    population.zip_code.str.fullmatch(r"\d{5}(?:-\d{4})?"), "").str[:1].replace("", "Other format")
population["train_count"] = training.groupby("row").size().reindex(range(N)).to_numpy()
population["log_train_count"] = np.log1p(population.train_count)
population["mean_rating"] = training.groupby("row").rating.mean().reindex(range(N)).to_numpy()
popularity = training.groupby("source_item_id").size().reindex(source_item_ids, fill_value=0)
training["log_item_popularity"] = np.log1p(training.source_item_id.map(popularity))
population["mean_log_item_popularity"] = training.groupby("row").log_item_popularity.mean().reindex(range(N)).to_numpy()
population["activity_decile"] = pd.qcut(population.train_count, q=10, labels=False, duplicates="drop").astype(int)
X = csr_matrix((np.ones(len(training), dtype=np.float64),
                (training.row.to_numpy(), training.column.to_numpy())),
               shape=(N, len(source_item_ids)), dtype=np.float64)
X.sum_duplicates()
X.data[:] = 1.0
assert np.isfinite(population[["train_count", "mean_rating", "mean_log_item_popularity"]]).all().all()

display(pd.DataFrame([
    {"scope": "Raw", "users": ratings.source_user_id.nunique(), "items": ratings.source_item_id.nunique(), "interactions": len(ratings)},
    {"scope": "Retained", "users": N, "items": len(source_item_ids), "interactions": len(retained)},
    {"scope": "Training only", "users": N, "items": training.source_item_id.nunique(), "interactions": len(training)},
    {"scope": "Held out (excluded from features)", "users": N, "items": held_out.source_item_id.nunique(), "interactions": len(held_out)},
]))
display(pd.DataFrame(filter_rounds))
print(f"Postal codes: {population.zip_code.nunique():,} distinct; "
      f"{(population.postal_prefix == 'Other format').sum()} users in other-format category.")
del ratings, retained, held_out, sequence_index, sequence_size

3. Refit the same five preference clusters¶

Code (click to collapse)
In [3]:
with threadpool_limits(limits=1):
    normalized = normalize(X, norm="l2", axis=1, copy=True)
    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=CLUSTER_CONFIG["n_components"], algorithm="randomized",
                       n_iter=CLUSTER_CONFIG["svd_n_iter"], random_state=CLUSTER_CONFIG["svd_seed"])
    reduced = np.asarray(svd.fit_transform(normalized), dtype=np.float64)
    components = np.asarray(svd.components_, dtype=np.float64).copy()
    for j, component in enumerate(components):
        pivot = int(np.argmax(np.abs(component)))
        if component[pivot] < 0:
            components[j] *= -1.0
            reduced[:, j] *= -1.0
    reduced_unit = np.asarray(normalize(reduced, norm="l2", axis=1, copy=True), dtype=np.float64)
    kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=CLUSTER_CONFIG["n_clusters"], n_init=CLUSTER_CONFIG["n_init"],
                    random_state=CLUSTER_CONFIG["kmeans_seed"], algorithm="lloyd")
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter("error", ConvergenceWarning)
        raw_labels = kmeans.fit_predict(reduced_unit)
    center_order = sorted(range(5), key=lambda i: tuple(float(x) for x in kmeans.cluster_centers_[i]))
    relabel = {old: new for new, old in enumerate(center_order)}
    cluster_labels = np.array([relabel[int(x)] for x in raw_labels], dtype=np.int64)
population["cluster"] = cluster_labels
assert set(cluster_labels) == set(range(5))

genres = sorted({genre for value in catalog.genres for genre in value.split("|")})
genre_matrix = np.array([[genre in value.split("|") for genre in genres]
                         for value in catalog.genres], dtype=np.float64)
genre_shares = np.asarray(X @ genre_matrix) / np.asarray(X.sum(axis=1))
genre_frame = pd.DataFrame(genre_shares, columns=genres)
# A multi-genre item contributes to each of its genres, so shares need not sum to one.
cluster_genres = genre_frame.groupby(population.cluster).mean()
cluster_summary = population.groupby("cluster").agg(
    users=("source_user_id", "size"), female_share=("gender", lambda x: (x == "F").mean()),
    median_training_interactions=("train_count", "median"),
    mean_training_interactions=("train_count", "mean"), mean_training_rating=("mean_rating", "mean"),
    modal_age_band=("age", lambda x: x.mode().iloc[0]),
    modal_occupation=("occupation", lambda x: x.mode().iloc[0]),
)
cluster_summary.insert(1, "population_share", cluster_summary.users / N)
cluster_summary["top_three_genres"] = [
    ", ".join(cluster_genres.loc[c].nlargest(3).index) for c in cluster_summary.index
]
provenance["cluster_assignments_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(
    np.column_stack([source_user_ids, cluster_labels]).astype("<i8").tobytes()).hexdigest()
provenance["binary_training_matrix_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(
    X.indptr.astype("<i8").tobytes() + X.indices.astype("<i8").tobytes()).hexdigest()
print(f"SVD explained variance (32 components): {svd.explained_variance_ratio_.sum():.3f}")
display(cluster_summary.round(4))
print("Cluster assignment hash:", provenance["cluster_assignments_sha256"])

def distribution_table(column, labels=None):
    counts = population[column].value_counts().sort_index()
    table = pd.DataFrame({"users": counts, "population_share": counts/N})
    if labels is not None:
        table.insert(0, "label", table.index.map(labels))
    table["expected_active_at_100"] = table.population_share * N_ACTIVE
    table["expected_reserve_at_200"] = table.population_share * N_RESERVE
    return table

display(distribution_table("gender").round(4))
display(distribution_table("age_code", AGE_LABELS).round(4))
display(distribution_table("occupation_code", OCC_LABELS).round(4))
display(distribution_table("postal_prefix").round(4))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(16, 6), layout="constrained")

    (axes[0], "gender", None, "Recorded gender"),
    (axes[1], "age_code", AGE_LABELS, "Age bands"),
    (axes[2], "occupation_code", OCC_LABELS, "Occupations"),
]:
    table = distribution_table(column, labels)
    names = table["label"] if labels else table.index
    y = np.arange(len(table))
    ax.barh(y, table.population_share, color="#6B7280")
    ax.set_yticks(y, names, fontsize=9)
    ax.invert_yaxis()
    ax.set(title=title, xlabel="Share of all users", xlim=(0, 1))
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1))
    for row, value in enumerate(table.population_share):
        ax.text(value + 0.01, row, f"{value:.1%}", va="center", fontsize=8)
plt.show()

5. Two explicit sampling recipes¶

Code (click to collapse)
In [6]:
cluster_positions = [np.flatnonzero(cluster_labels == c) for c in range(5)]
cluster_sizes = np.array([len(x) for x in cluster_positions], dtype=np.int64)

def proportional_quota(n, sizes):
    expected = n * np.asarray(sizes, dtype=float) / np.sum(sizes)
    allocation = np.floor(expected).astype(np.int64)
    remaining = n - int(allocation.sum())
    order = np.lexsort((np.arange(len(sizes)), -(expected - allocation)))
    allocation[order[:remaining]] += 1
    assert allocation.sum() == n and np.all(allocation >= 0)
    return allocation

active_quota = proportional_quota(N_ACTIVE, cluster_sizes)
reserve_quota = proportional_quota(N_RESERVE, cluster_sizes)
assert np.all(active_quota > 0) and np.all(reserve_quota > 0)
assert np.all(active_quota + reserve_quota <= cluster_sizes)

def draw_panel(seed, method):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(int(seed))
    if method == "Current permutation":
        order = rng.permutation(np.arange(N))
        active, reserve = order[:N_ACTIVE], order[N_ACTIVE:N_ACTIVE + N_RESERVE]
    elif method == "Cluster stratified":
        a, r = [], []
        for c, positions in enumerate(cluster_positions):
            order = rng.permutation(positions)
            a.append(order[:active_quota[c]])
            r.append(order[active_quota[c]:active_quota[c] + reserve_quota[c]])
        active, reserve = rng.permutation(np.concatenate(a)), rng.permutation(np.concatenate(r))
    else:
        raise ValueError(method)
    return active, reserve

quota_table = pd.DataFrame({
    "cluster": range(5), "population_n": cluster_sizes, "population_share": cluster_sizes / N,
    "active_n": active_quota, "reserve_n": reserve_quota, "combined_n": active_quota + reserve_quota,
    "active_base_inclusion_probability": active_quota / cluster_sizes,
    "reserve_base_inclusion_probability": reserve_quota / cluster_sizes,
}).set_index("cluster")
display(quota_table.round(5))
# These probabilities describe an unscreened stratified draw, not the final seed-selected design.
for seed in (0, 42, 43, 44, 19999):
    for method in METHODS:
        a, r = draw_panel(seed, method)
        assert len(a) == 100 and len(r) == 200 and len(set(a) | set(r)) == 300
        a2, r2 = draw_panel(seed, method)
        assert np.array_equal(a, a2) and np.array_equal(r, r2)
        if method == "Cluster stratified":
            assert np.array_equal(np.bincount(cluster_labels[a], minlength=5), active_quota)
            assert np.array_equal(np.bincount(cluster_labels[r], minlength=5), reserve_quota)
# Explicit parity with the current sampler's permutation of sorted runtime user IDs.
legacy_draw = np.random.default_rng(42).permutation(np.arange(1, N + 1))
a, r = draw_panel(42, "Current permutation")
assert np.array_equal(a + 1, legacy_draw[:100])
assert np.array_equal(r + 1, legacy_draw[100:300])

6. Balance metrics¶

population["cluster_age"] = population.cluster.astype(str) + "|" + population.age_code.astype(str)
cat_columns = ["cluster", "gender", "age_code", "occupation_code", "postal_prefix",
               "activity_decile", "cluster_age"]
cat_metric = ["cluster_tvd", "gender_tvd", "age_tvd", "occupation_tvd",
              "postal_prefix_tvd", "activity_decile_tvd", "cluster_age_tvd"]
feature_blocks, feature_slices, levels = [], {}, {}
offset = 0
for column in cat_columns:
    categories = sorted(population[column].unique())
    levels[column] = categories
    values = pd.Categorical(population[column], categories=categories).codes
    block = np.eye(len(categories), dtype=np.float64)[values]
    feature_blocks.append(block)
    feature_slices[column] = slice(offset, offset + len(categories))
    offset += len(categories)

behavior_names = ["train_count", "log_train_count", "mean_rating", "mean_log_item_popularity"]
behavior = population[behavior_names].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
behavior_z = (behavior - behavior.mean(axis=0)) / behavior.std(axis=0, ddof=0)
genre_sd = genre_shares.std(axis=0, ddof=0)
assert np.all(genre_sd > 0)
genre_z = (genre_shares - genre_shares.mean(axis=0)) / genre_sd
behavior_slice = slice(offset, offset + behavior_z.shape[1])
offset = behavior_slice.stop
genre_slice = slice(offset, offset + genre_z.shape[1])
FEATURES = np.concatenate([*feature_blocks, behavior_z, genre_z], axis=1)
population_feature_mean = FEATURES.mean(axis=0)
metric_names = list(TOLERANCES.columns)
metric_index = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(metric_names)}
limits = TOLERANCES.to_numpy()

def panel_metrics(active, reserve):
    means = np.vstack([FEATURES[active].mean(axis=0), FEATURES[reserve].mean(axis=0)])
    means = np.vstack([means, (N_ACTIVE * means[0] + N_RESERVE * means[1]) / (N_ACTIVE + N_RESERVE)])
    differences = np.abs(means - population_feature_mean)
    values = np.empty((3, len(metric_names)), dtype=float)
    for column, metric in zip(cat_columns, cat_metric):
        values[:, metric_index[metric]] = differences[:, feature_slices[column]].sum(axis=1) / 2
    values[:, metric_index["behavior_max_smd"]] = differences[:, behavior_slice].max(axis=1)
    values[:, metric_index["genre_mean_abs_smd"]] = differences[:, genre_slice].mean(axis=1)
    return values

def metric_record(seed, method):
    active, reserve = draw_panel(seed, method)
    values = panel_metrics(active, reserve)
    ratios = values / limits
    result = {"method": method, "seed": int(seed), "worst_ratio": float(ratios.max()),
              "mean_ratio": float(ratios.mean()), "passes": bool(np.all(ratios <= 1 + 1e-12))}
    noncluster = [metric_index[m] for m in metric_names if m != "cluster_tvd"]
    result["mean_ratio_excluding_cluster"] = float(ratios[:, noncluster].mean())
    for role_index, role in enumerate(ROLES):
        for j, name in enumerate(metric_names):
            result[f"{role}|{name}"] = float(values[role_index, j])
    return result

assert np.isfinite(FEATURES).all()
print(f"Scoring {len(metric_names)} criteria for each of {len(ROLES)} roles; "
      f"{FEATURES.shape[1]} underlying measured/derived feature columns.")

9. Selected panel overlap¶

Code (click to collapse)
In [11]:
membership_frames = []
selected_id_lists = {}
for seed, (active, reserve) in selected_panels.items():
    selected_id_lists[seed] = {}
    for role, positions in (("Active", active), ("Reserve", reserve)):
        part = population.iloc[positions][[
            "source_user_id", "runtime_user_id", "cluster", "gender", "age_code", "occupation_code",
        ]].copy()
        part.insert(0, "role_order", np.arange(len(part)))
        part.insert(0, "role", role)
        part.insert(0, "population_seed", seed)
        membership_frames.append(part)
        selected_id_lists[seed][role.lower()] = [int(x) for x in part.source_user_id]
selected_membership = pd.concat(membership_frames, ignore_index=True)
assert len(selected_membership) == 900
assert selected_membership.groupby("population_seed").source_user_id.nunique().eq(300).all()
assert set(selected_membership.source_user_id).issubset(set(source_user_ids))
for seed in SELECTED_SEEDS:
    a, r = draw_panel(seed, "Cluster stratified")
    assert selected_id_lists[seed]["active"] == source_user_ids[a].tolist()
    assert selected_id_lists[seed]["reserve"] == source_user_ids[r].tolist()
    assert np.all(panel_metrics(a, r) <= limits + 1e-12)

overlap_rows = []
for i, s1 in enumerate(SELECTED_SEEDS):
    for s2 in SELECTED_SEEDS[i+1:]:
        a1, r1 = map(set, selected_panels[s1])
        a2, r2 = map(set, selected_panels[s2])
        p1, p2 = a1 | r1, a2 | r2
        overlap_rows.append({"seed_1": s1, "seed_2": s2, "active_overlap": len(a1 & a2),
                             "reserve_overlap": len(r1 & r2), "combined_overlap": len(p1 & p2),
                             "combined_Jaccard": len(p1 & p2) / len(p1 | p2)})
display(pd.DataFrame(overlap_rows).round(4))
UNIQUE_PROFILE_USERS = selected_membership.source_user_id.nunique()
print(f"Unique selected users across all three panels: {UNIQUE_PROFILE_USERS} / 900 slots.")

provenance["selected_population_seeds"] = list(SELECTED_SEEDS)
provenance["membership_sha256"] = {
    str(seed): hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(selected_id_lists[seed], sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
    for seed in SELECTED_SEEDS
}
provenance["selected_scores"] = json.loads(recommended[compact_cols].to_json(orient="records"))
print(json.dumps(provenance, indent=2))

10. Integrity checks¶

Code (click to collapse)
In [14]:
# Final checks remain local and read-only: no input/export/model directories are created.
assert all(file_sha256(DATA / name) == digest for name, digest in provenance["raw_files"].items())
assert all(file_sha256(MITIGATION / "data_preparation" / name) == digest
           for name, digest in provenance["reference_source_files"].items())
assert len(SELECTED_SEEDS) == 3 and len(set(SELECTED_SEEDS)) == 3
assert recommended.passes.all()
for seed, (a, r) in selected_panels.items():
    assert len(a) == 100 and len(r) == 200
    assert set(a).isdisjoint(set(r))
    assert len(set(a) | set(r)) == 300
    assert np.array_equal(np.bincount(cluster_labels[a], minlength=5), active_quota)
    assert np.array_equal(np.bincount(cluster_labels[r], minlength=5), reserve_quota)
print("PASS — 6,040 users clustered; three reproducible disjoint-role panels; all balance gates met; source files unchanged.")
print("Selected population seeds:", SELECTED_SEEDS)

if EXPORT_LOCAL_RESULTS:
    output_directory = ROOT / "datasets/processed/population_selection"
    output_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    membership_columns = ["population_seed", "role", "role_order", "source_user_id", "runtime_user_id", "cluster"]
    selected_membership[membership_columns].to_csv(output_directory / "membership.csv", index=False)
    recommended.to_csv(output_directory / "selected_scores.csv", index=False)
    selected_metrics.to_csv(output_directory / "selected_metrics.csv", index=False)
    TOLERANCES.rename_axis("role").to_csv(output_directory / "tolerances.csv")
    summary.to_csv(output_directory / "search_summary.csv")
    category_balance.to_csv(output_directory / "category_balance.csv", index=False)
    (output_directory / "provenance.json").write_text(json.dumps(provenance, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
